messages:
Maya Chen: quick sync — i need a fast triage on instrumentation priorities for the console obs roadmap. we have limited eng cycles this sprint so want to decide what gets shipped vs snuck into next milestone. high-level list: dashboards (per-model + per-route), tracing hooks for long-tail latency, error-analysis views (top exceptions + repro prompts), and retention config (30/90/180 day options). where do we land?
Ian Park: +1. can we enumerate ownership for each piece? which teams will own dashboard wiring vs trace hooks? also any blocker PRs?
Maya Chen: ownership proposal: eng-platform owns dashboard infra + query layer, eng-runtime owns trace hooks + sampling, eng-sre owns retention policy + infra ops. open blockers: runtime needs a small API change to surface span IDs to the console.
Shawn Patel: FYI i have a pending PR that adds span-id header into inference responses — draft at https://git.internal/r/sha/4123 (needs review). if we accept that we can wire traces into the console. tagging @Ian for review.
Ian Park: thanks — i can take a look today. rough checklist for reviewing: 1) header name (x-rd-span) 2) backwards compatibility when header missing 3) tests for propagation across batching.
Olga Smirnova: re: retention, legal asked for a 90-day default for EU customers and 30-day for orgs with PII flags. we should expose a per-team setting in console and a global policy fallback. also need audit logs for retention changes.
Maya Chen: good call. can we sketch the UI flow? small mock: retention dropdown in dataset settings with tooltip. we also need an audit log entry + email notif on changes for enterprise tiers.
Shawn Patel: quick ask — is the retention work gated on any infra changes? we might need a tiered S3 lifecycle + faster purging job. ops cost estimate?
ConsoleBot: deployment-check — infra/deploy/purge-job pipeline failed on staging at 2026-03-12T08:14:22Z, error: "timeout deleting objects". (job id: purge-20260312-7f).
Ian Park: that purge-job failure is the blocker Shawn mentioned. eng-infra needs to increase S3 retry windows and add backoff. i will raise a ticket and assign to eng-infra.
Olga Smirnova: for the error-analysis view — proposal: top exceptions by model + routes, quick filters for prompt length and user-agent, and a 'repro prompt' pane that stores sanitized input for eval. need product signoff on privacy here.
Maya Chen: product already ok'd sanitized repros, but legal requires PII redaction. add a redaction step before storing repros.
Shawn Patel: low-level note: for tracing hooks we should allow sampling config per-customer. e.g., sample_rate=0.01 by default, override for premium orgs. code sketch: ```yaml
traces:
  sample_rate: 0.01
  headers: ["x-rd-span"]
```
Ian Park: agree. also add a quick fallback route: if span header missing, route to best-effort synthetic span using request-id + timestamp. avoids gaps in traces.
Maya Chen: ok action items (short):
- Ian: review span-id PR and merge if clean (ETA today)
- Shawn: follow up with eng-infra on purge-job retry changes + cost estimate (ETA EOD)
- Olga: design mock for retention UI + PII redaction spec (ETA 2 days)
- Eng-infra (TBD): fix purge-job, increase S3 retry/backoff (blocker)
- Product: signoff on repro storage + email audit flow (ping product channel)
Olga Smirnova: will add the UI mock to the design board and tag product.
Shawn Patel: pinging @Ian again on the PR — i added tests but could use a quick eyeball.
Ian Park: i looked, left 2 small comments. nothing blocking. merge after CI passes. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: thanks team. i'll update the roadmap ticket with these owners and move traces to 'blocked' until purge-job fix is in. will post updates in the morning.
ConsoleBot: reminder — slack thread linked to ticket INF-5273 (Console Observability: instrumentation triage).
